name: ContentZavod
author: fittinai

sections.description:
ContentZavod is a powerful WordPress plugin that automatically integrates quality content into your website, helping improve SEO and increase traffic. The plugin works through a secure API and requires no technical knowledge to set up.

Key Features

  • 🔄 Automatic content retrieval through API in real-time
  • 🗺️ Sitemap integration with automatic robots.txt addition
  • ⚙️ Easy setup with intuitive multilingual admin panel
  • 🔐 Secure API token storage
  • 📱 Full mobile device support
  • 🚀 SEO optimization with proper URL structure
  • ⚡ Built-in caching for fast loading (30 minutes)
  • 🎨 Automatic link adaptation to your domain
  • 🌍 Multilingual support (10 languages)

Supported Languages

  • 🇷🇺 Russian (Русский)
  • 🇬🇧 English
  • 🇪🇸 Spanish (Español)
  • 🇩🇪 German (Deutsch)
  • 🇫🇷 French (Français)
  • 🇮🇹 Italian (Italiano)
  • 🇵🇹 Portuguese (Português)
  • 🇨🇳 Chinese (中文)
  • 🇯🇵 Japanese (日本語)
  • 🇸🇦 Arabic (العربية)

Requirements

  • WordPress 5.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Valid ContentZavod API token
  • Enabled wp_remote_get() function

URL Structure

After installation, content will be available at:

  • Main page: /contentzavod/ – List of all news
  • Single article: /contentzavod/view/{slug} – Full article text
  • Sitemap: /contentzavod-sitemap.xml – XML sitemap

Compatibility

Tested and compatible with:

  • Yoast SEO
  • All in One SEO Pack
  • WP Super Cache
  • W3 Total Cache
  • LiteSpeed Cache
  • Most WordPress themes

External Services

This plugin connects to the ContentZavod API service to automatically generate and publish SEO/GEO-optimized content for your website.

What is ContentZavod?

ContentZavod is an automated content generation service that monitors up to 80 news sources (RSS feeds, Telegram channels), analyzes content relevance and sentiment, and generates up to 5 unique articles per day optimized for your business niche.

What data is sent?

The plugin sends the following data to the ContentZavod API (https://ainews-back.fittin.ru):
* Your API token (for authentication)
* Article slug/path (when requesting specific content)
* User-Agent header (for technical compatibility)

When is data sent?

Data is transmitted in the following cases:
* When a visitor accesses content URLs (/contentzavod/view/{slug})
* When requesting the sitemap (/contentzavod-sitemap.xml)
* When accessing the main news page (/contentzavod/)

Service Information:

  • Service Website: https://newsai.fittin.ru/
  • Terms of Service: https://contentzavod.fittin.ru/offerta/latest
  • Privacy Policy: https://contentzavod.fittin.ru/privacy_policy.pdf

The service is provided by LLC “Digital Technologies” (FITTIN™), a Russian company specializing in AI-powered content generation and SEO optimization.

Important: This plugin requires an active ContentZavod subscription and API token to function. Content is generated and stored on ContentZavod servers and delivered to your site in real-time through the API.

Support

For support, please visit:

  • Website: contentzavod.fittin.ru
  • Email: support@fittin.ru
  • Documentation: contentzavod.fittin.ru/docs

Privacy Policy

This plugin:
* Does not collect or store any personal user data
* Only stores the API token in WordPress database
* Makes API requests to contentzavod.fittin.ru for content retrieval
* Does not use cookies or tracking
* Does not share data with third parties

Credits

Made with ❤️ by Fittin team.
sections.installation:
Through WordPress Admin Panel (Recommended)

  1. Log in to WordPress admin panel
  2. Go to Plugins → Add New
  3. Click “Upload Plugin”
  4. Select contentzavod.zip file
  5. Click “Install Now”, then “Activate”

Manually via FTP

  1. Unzip contentzavod.zip
  2. Upload contentzavod folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  3. Activate the plugin in WordPress admin panel

Configuration

  1. Register at contentzavod.fittin.ru and get an API token
  2. Go to Settings → ContentZavod
  3. Enter API token in the field
  4. Click “Save Settings”
  5. Go to Settings → Permalinks and click “Save Changes”
  6. Open https://your-site.com/contentzavod/ to verify
sections.faq:
Where can I get an API token?

Register at contentzavod.fittin.ru and get an API token in your personal account.

Why am I getting a 404 error?

Update permalinks: go to Settings → Permalinks and click “Save Changes” without changing anything.

Is the plugin compatible with caching plugins?

Yes, the plugin is fully compatible with popular caching plugins like WP Super Cache, W3 Total Cache, and LiteSpeed Cache.

How do I change the plugin language?

The plugin automatically uses the WordPress language. To change it, go to Settings → General → Site Language.

Is the plugin secure?

Yes, the API token is stored encrypted in the WordPress database, all API requests use HTTPS, and the plugin includes protection against SQL injection and XSS attacks.
